tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background (shadcn --background). foreground and muted-foreground text sit on it. Tailwind: bg-background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, card, header, inset, muted and secondary (shadcn --foreground). Tailwind: text-foreground.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, table, dialog and task rows (shadcn --card). foreground, muted-foreground, link, destructive and warning text sit on it. Tailwind: bg-card.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card (shadcn --card-foreground).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Select menus and popovers (shadcn --popover).

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent (shadcn --primary): default button, logo mark, avatar, In progress bar segment. Tailwind: bg-primary.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. Dark text in dark, white in light. Tailwind: text-primary-foreground.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Neutral fill (shadcn --secondary): secondary button, To do badge, neutral icon tile, disabled primary button.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Toggle-group track and read-only input fill (shadcn --muted). foreground and muted-foreground text on it.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, labels, inactive nav, on background, card, header, inset and muted. At least 4.5:1 in both themes. Tailwind: text-muted-foreground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selected or hovered fill (shadcn --accent): active nav pill, selected toggle option, ghost hover. foreground text on it.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Logout and delete icons, required asterisk, on background, header and card (shadcn --destructive). Used as text and outline, not as a filled button. Always with a label or aria-label.

tokens.name: destructive-border
tokens.usage: Border of the destructive (outline) button.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px border of cards, table, dialog and the app bar (shadcn --border). Tailwind: border-border.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, outline buttons, icon buttons, toggle group and the user pill (shadcn --input). Decorative level (about 1.3:1 dark, 1.5:1 light); the ring signals state.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring and focused input border (shadcn --ring). At least 3:1 on background, card and inset in both themes.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: App bar background. foreground and muted-foreground text sit on it. Tailwind: bg-header (extension).

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Fill of text inputs and selects. foreground text on it. Tailwind: bg-inset (extension).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Row separators inside cards and tables. Tailwind: border-divider (extension).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links such as View all, on background and card. Tailwind: text-link (extension).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Filled done checkbox and the Completed progress segment. Never alone: a Done badge or label goes with it.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Check mark on a success fill (icon, 3:1 or better).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due today text and the To do caption, on card and background.

tokens.name: check-ring
tokens.usage: Ring of the unchecked round checkbox. At least 3:1 on card.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Completed segment of the progress bar (shadcn chart color 1).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: In progress segment of the progress bar (shadcn chart color 2).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: To do segment of the progress bar (shadcn chart color 3); graphic, 3:1 on card in light.

tokens.name: priority-high
tokens.usage: High priority badge fill.

tokens.name: priority-high-foreground
tokens.usage: High priority badge text on priority-high.

tokens.name: priority-medium
tokens.usage: Medium priority badge fill.

tokens.name: priority-medium-foreground
tokens.usage: Medium priority badge text on priority-medium.

tokens.name: priority-low
tokens.usage: Low priority badge fill.

tokens.name: priority-low-foreground
tokens.usage: Low priority badge text on priority-low.

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: In progress badge and stat tile fill.

tokens.name: status-progress-foreground
tokens.usage: In progress badge text and icon on status-progress.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done badge and Completed stat tile fill.

tokens.name: status-done-foreground
tokens.usage: Done badge text and icon on status-done.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the dialog. The consumer paints it. Tailwind: bg-overlay (extension).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page title (h1), one per screen, foreground. Tailwind: font-display text-[42px] leading-[46px] font-bold tracking-tight.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Dialog title. Tailwind: font-display text-[28px] leading-8 font-bold tracking-tight.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Card and section titles. Tailwind: font-display text-[22px] leading-7 font-semibold tracking-tight.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Numbers in stat cards and profile counts. Tailwind: font-display text-5xl leading-none font-bold tracking-tight.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: App name in the header. Tailwind: font-display text-[19px] leading-6 font-bold tracking-tight.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: 1 task is due today and 8 are still to do.
styles.usage: Page subtitle; task titles at font-semibold. Tailwind: text-base.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Input text and table row titles. Tailwind: text-[15px] leading-[22px].

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Document the REST routes and example payloads.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, footers; field labels at font-semibold. Tailwind: text-[13px] leading-[18px].

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav links, tabs, small buttons. Tailwind: text-sm font-medium.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Default button label. Tailwind: text-[15px] font-semibold.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Priority and status badges. Tailwind: text-xs font-medium.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Date eyebrow above the page title. Tailwind: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em].

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Table column headers in muted-foreground. Tailwind: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em].

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tailwind 1 (gap-1, p-1): gap between toggle options and nav pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tailwind 2: gap between badges, label and field, button icon and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tailwind 3: gap between toolbar controls and dialog buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tailwind 4: gap between a checkbox and its text, stat card grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tailwind 5: stat card vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tailwind 6: row and card header padding, gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Tailwind 7: dialog and form card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tailwind 8: page side padding and gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Tailwind 11: top padding of the page content area.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tailwind rounded-sm: selected option inside toggle groups and tabs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tailwind rounded-md, equal to shadcn --radius: buttons, inputs, icon buttons, control containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tailwind rounded-lg: shortcut link cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Tailwind rounded-card (theme extension): stat cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Tailwind rounded-xl: content cards and the table card.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Tailwind rounded-2xl: dialog.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tailwind rounded-full: badges, nav pills, user pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Tailwind shadow-card (theme extension): cards in light only; dark relies on borders.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Tailwind shadow-dialog (theme extension): the dialog surface.
